response.sql: WITH funding AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx <> 0 THEN (s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx END) AS average_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM funding) SELECT f.funding_source, f.average_y_vs_x_difference, f.area_to_volume_ratio, f.area_to_volume_ratio - b.average_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM funding AS f CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE f.area_to_volume_ratio > b.average_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A funding source’s area-to-volume ratio is its total area divided by its total volume, using records where both values are present. Funding sources with no defined ratio are excluded from the benchmark.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio for each funding source is the average of its per-record area-to-volume ratios.
